dimensions.assessment: Affects personnel at specific FAA contract air traffic control towers, airport sponsors, and air traffic controllers.
dimensions.evidence: air traffic control towers of the Federal Aviation Administration that are operating under contract

dimensions.assessment: Upgrades safety equipment and situational awareness tools at applicable contract towers, including training and operational integration.
dimensions.evidence: acquire and install certified Airborne Position Reference Tools at air traffic control towers

dimensions.assessment: Authorizes expenditures for equipment acquisition, installation, operating expenses, and retroactive reimbursements or grant funding, without specifying aggregate dollar sums.
dimensions.evidence: The acquisition, installation, and annual operating expenses of certified Airborne Position Reference Tools

dimensions.assessment: Amends title 49 of the United States Code regarding contract tower equipment, funding, and training programs.
dimensions.evidence: Section 47124(f)(2) of title 49, United States Code, is amended

dimensions.assessment: Mandates installation within 1 year and authorizes ongoing annual operating expenses.
dimensions.evidence: Not later than 1 year after the date of enactment of this section, the Administrator... shall acquire and install

missing_information: Total expected financial cost or budget allocation for acquiring and installing the equipment is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: Requires the FAA to acquire, install, and maintain certified airborne position reference tools or standard terminal automation replacement systems at specific contract air traffic control towers, and provides for retroactive reimbursements.
